entities.summary: Sindika Dokolo (b. 1972-03-16, Kinshasa) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kinshasa and Democratic Republic of the Congo. Known in the fields of democratic republic of the congo, merchants & economists, africa.
